analytic_route: Prove cut-and-pole representation b_(2n+1)=C_n+(-1)^n P_n; all poles purely imaginary. For k<=K=8/25 prove C3 on[1,3/2]>3/500 and P3<3/500, then extend all n>=3 via cut/pole radius comparison. Even n coefficients positive. Therefore all degree>=5 Taylor coefficients positive.

certificate_rules.a3_sign: Independent fixed-point integer interval quadrature with explicit Taylor remainders for sin,cos,exp and an analytic second-derivative midpoint error bound. Check k=.32, .3183, .3184. No black-box transcendental interval package is necessary for these sign certificates.

certificate_rules.power_and_legendre_scans: Run the already frozen exploratory k list; degree101 Taylor and ell101 Legendre checks corroborate, never replace the tail proof.
